components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast white button for primary actions. The brightest interactive element on screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ffffff; color: #0f0f0f; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 8px; height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0f0f0f, 0 0 0 4px #ffffff; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Mid-surface button for secondary actions. Blends into the UI at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #252525; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 8px; height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #2d2d2d; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0f0f0f, 0 0 0 4px #ffffff; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent button that reveals itself on hover. For toolbar actions and inline controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 8px; height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #1a1a1a; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0f0f0f, 0 0 0 4px #ffffff; }

components.name: Twitch Button
components.description: Platform-specific button for Twitch actions only. Never as a general accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-twitch { background: #9146ff; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 8px; height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-twitch:hover { background: #772ce8; } .ds-btn-twitch:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0f0f0f, 0 0 0 4px #9146ff; }

components.name: Kick Button
components.description: Platform-specific button for Kick actions only. Never as a general accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-kick { background: #53fc18; color: #0f0f0f; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 8px; height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-kick:hover { background: #3dd912; } .ds-btn-kick:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0f0f0f, 0 0 0 4px #53fc18; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard container. Dark Surface background, subtle border, no shadow at rest.
components.html:
Card Title
Card content goes here.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #1a1a1a; border: 1px solid #333333; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; color: #a0a0a0; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Compact pill for stream tags, language labels, and category filters.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #4a4d55; color: #efeff1; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: default; transition: background 200ms ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #5a5d66; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation link. Icon + label, fills on hover, solid on active.
components.html: Home
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background 200ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #252525; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: #3f3f46; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff; }

components.name: Live Badge
components.description: Compact red pill overlaid on stream thumbnails. Pulses softly to signal live state.
components.css: .ds-live-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #dc2626; color: #ffffff; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; animation: ds-pulse-soft 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse-soft { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.7; } }

narrative.overview:
The stream is the show. StreamFusion is the dark room around the screen: invisible when the content plays, ambient when you glance away, instantly responsive when you reach for a control. Every element exists to frame the content, not to compete with it.

The system is dark by conviction, not by trend. Streamers broadcast against black; the UI honors that by refusing to introduce competing light sources. Surfaces step through four tonal layers (#0f0f0f to #2d2d2d) to create spatial hierarchy without a single shadow at rest. When interaction demands attention (popovers, dialogs, dropdowns), subtle shadows lift elements off the stage, then vanish.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal layering with four deliberate surface steps
Crimson accent used sparingly for live states and critical actions
Platform colors (Twitch purple, Kick green) as contextual accents, never the identity
Inter as the sole typeface: clean, dense, optimized for small sizes
Tactile interactions: elements respond immediately to input with color shifts and subtle transforms

rules.name: The Stage Light Rule
rules.body: Storm Crimson appears on no more than 5% of any given screen. Its scarcity is what makes the live badge pulse with urgency. If crimson is everywhere, nothing is live.

rules.name: The Platform Guest Rule
rules.body: Twitch Purple and Kick Green are guests in StreamFusion's house. They identify their platform, then step back. Never use them as general UI accents, hover states, or decorative elements.

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Inter is the only typeface. No display fonts, no monospace for style, no serif accents. One voice, many weights.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No surface has a shadow at rest. If you're writing box-shadow on a card, container, or section, stop. Use a tonal background step instead. Shadows are reserved for elements that appear, then vanish.

dos: Do use the four tonal surface steps (#0f0f0f, #1a1a1a, #252525, #2d2d2d) as the primary depth language. Every new container should be exactly one step lighter than its parent.
Do keep Storm Crimson (#dc143c) below 5% of any screen's surface area. If it's on more than the live badge and one CTA, it's overused.
Do use platform colors (Twitch Purple, Kick Green) exclusively for platform identification: badges, connect buttons, platform indicators. Nowhere else.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion. All animations must degrade to instant state changes.
Do maintain WCAG AA contrast: 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text and interactive elements.
Do keep transitions fast: 200ms for color/opacity, 300ms for transforms.
donts: Don't use neon gradients, RGB glow effects, or angular esports-style shapes.
Don't replicate Twitch or Kick's visual language. No purple-dominant or green-dominant themes.
Don't add shadows to resting surfaces. Cards, sections, containers: flat.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as colored accent stripes.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. backdrop-blur is functional, not aesthetic.
Don't build the hero-metric template (big number, small label, gradient accent).
Don't let the UI feel like a web page in a window.
